text:
Sam P.: Heads up — vendor sent a signed PO to marketplace but it's failing our ingest. Attachment looks like ISO-8859-1 XML and signature is SHA1withRSA (pkcs7) not matching marketplace PKCS7 detached-SHA256. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Maria (Procurement): Can you paste the header or example? We need to tell them exact format or reject.
Sam P.: here's excerpt from vendor PO (they sent as attachment):
```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>
<PurchaseOrder id="PO-98765">
  <Total>15000.00</Total>
  <Signature algorithm="SHA1withRSA" />
</PurchaseOrder>
```
Elaine K.: AWS expects UTF-8 and detached PKCS7 with SHA256 in the marketplace connector. If signature algorithm doesn't match it fails verification.
Raj (Legal): Is this a redline we accept or a rejection? If vendor can't re-sign, do we accept their provenance? Risky.
Sam P.: marketplace-inbound logs show error: `signature_verification_failed: unsupported_digest_algorithm: sha1` — inbound rejected.
aws-marketplace-bot: [timestamp 3111112230] Inbound PO id PO-98765 rejected. Reason: unsupported_digest_algorithm
Maria (Procurement): I'll ping vendor procurement. @sam do we have a one-pager with exact requirements to share? I recall SalesOps made a checklist.
Olivia SalesOps: I have a checklist. Sending shortly. Quick Q: if vendor re-sends UTF-8 but keeps old cert, is that ok?
Raj (Legal): Cert algorithm matters less than digest algorithm used to create signature. Need re-sign with SHA256 or we can't verify. We can accept exception only with SOW amendment and higher approval.
Sam P.: Can someone drop the checklist and the exact log snippet I can forward?
Elaine K.: Copy this for the vendor: `- XML UTF-8; - detached PKCS7 signature; - digest SHA-256; - canonicalization: exclusive` Also link to our integration doc: https://redwood.example/marketplace/inbound-specs
Maria (Procurement): I'll reply to vendor with that and request re-signed PO within 48h. If no response escalate to channel.
Sam P.: Thanks. Will monitor. If they push back, we may need Sales to approve temporary manual acceptance.
Olivia SalesOps: noted, cc'ing account team. :thumbsup: 
Raj (Legal): If they ask for manual acceptance, loop in me + compliance. No exceptions without written doc.
Sam P.: last update: vendor acknowledged, re-issuing with SHA256. filing this thread for audit. Thanks all.
